shelters.name: Jacksonville Humane Society
shelters.description: Local independent 501c3 nonprofit caring for nearly 9,000 dogs and cats yearly. Offers adoption, low-cost vet care, training classes, and youth programs.

shelters.name: Pet Alliance of Greater Orlando
shelters.description: One of the region's oldest and largest animal welfare agencies since 1937. Formerly SPCA of Central Florida. Finds homes for 10,000+ pets yearly with no time limit policy.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Tampa Bay
shelters.description: Established in 1912 as Hillsborough County Humane Society, one of Florida's oldest corporations. Offers adoptions, low-cost vet care, and Pet Pantry program.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Greater Miami
shelters.description: Helping homeless animals in Miami-Dade since 1936. Limited admit, adoption guarantee facility caring for 300+ animals daily. Offers low-cost spay/neuter.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Broward County
shelters.description: Founded in 1944, providing shelter, aid and responsible adoptions while educating the community about respect and kindness to all animals.

shelters.name: SPCA Florida
shelters.description: Founded in 1979, independent nonprofit dedicated to improving lives of pets and people in Polk County and surrounding areas.

shelters.name: Peggy Adams Animal Rescue League
shelters.description: Since 1925, providing shelter to homeless animals, spay/neuter services, and finding quality homes for companion animals in Palm Beach County.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Pinellas
shelters.description: Strives to connect pets and people and help keep them together by providing resources and programs for those in need.

shelters.name: SPCA Tampa Bay
shelters.description: Only open-admission animal shelter and public veterinary center in Pinellas County. Cares for 8,000+ animals annually including injured wildlife.

shelters.name: Gulf Coast Humane Society
shelters.description: 501(c)3 nonprofit no-kill animal welfare organization established in 1947 serving Southwest Florida.

shelters.name: Florida Humane Society
shelters.description: Nonprofit animal shelter with main location in Pompano Beach and satellite locations in Coral Springs and Boca Raton PetSmart stores.

shelters.name: First Coast No More Homeless Pets
shelters.description: 501(c)3 nonprofit ending the killing of dogs and cats in shelters through spay/neuter programs and community initiatives in Northeast Florida.

shelters.name: South Florida SPCA
shelters.description: Private nonprofit 501(c)(3) dedicated to rescue, rehabilitation and adoption of abused, neglected and abandoned horses and livestock.

shelters.name: Pet Pal Animal Shelter
shelters.description: No-kill animal shelter serving the St. Petersburg area with adoption and rescue services.

shelters.name: Friends of Strays
shelters.description: No-kill cat sanctuary serving the St. Petersburg area with rescue and adoption services.

shelters.name: UFAR - United For Animals Rescue
shelters.description: No-kill pet rescue providing food, shelter, medical care. Rescued 856 pets in 2023 and currently shelters over 300 pets.

shelters.name: Barky Pines Animal Rescue & Sanctuary
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit no-kill rescue dedicated to homeless, special needs, and senior pets in Palm Beach County.

shelters.name: Operation Liberation
shelters.description: Dedicated to rescuing, rehabilitating and finding permanent homes for animals in South Florida.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Sumter County
shelters.description: Dedicated to supporting the health and well-being of animals in Sumter County while providing education.

shelters.name: Pet Alliance of Greater Orlando - Sanford
shelters.description: Sanford location of Pet Alliance of Greater Orlando serving Seminole County with adoption services.

shelters.name: Miami-Dade Animal Services
shelters.description: Miami-Dade County animal services providing animal control, shelter, and adoption services for the county.

shelters.name: Orange County Animal Services
shelters.description: Orange County government animal services providing shelter and adoption services for Orlando area.

shelters.name: Hillsborough County Pet Resource Center
shelters.description: Hillsborough County animal services providing shelter, adoption, and pet resource services for Tampa area.

shelters.name: Palm Beach County Animal Care and Control
shelters.description: Palm Beach County animal services providing shelter and adoption services for the county.

shelters.name: Brevard County Sheriff Animal Services
shelters.description: Brevard County animal services providing shelter and adoption services for the Space Coast area.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Florida animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Florida has one of the largest shelter systems in the US. Coverage spans major metros including Jacksonville, Orlando, Tampa, Miami, Fort Lauderdale, West Palm Beach, and surrounding areas. Humane Society of Tampa Bay (founded 1912) is one of Florida's oldest corporations.
